thread:
Lina (Design): quick check: finalizing compact inspector + export microflow for embeddings. key things: default collapsed rows for large sets, export CSV shape, example headers, and keyboard/a11y flow. latest mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-compact
Marcus (Product): customers reranking at scale want source_text as opt-in. also prefer explicit CTA text. keep inspector tight by default.
Noor (Eng): collapsed rows OK. we'll virtualize >500 rows and lazy-render previews. export options: CSV (floats), CSV (base64), JSONL.gz. propose CSV for <=1k, JSONL.gz for >1k.
Ollie (A11y): a11y notes: 1) collapse toggles need aria-expanded + aria-controls. 2) expanding must move focus into panel. 3) announce "N vectors loaded" on data load via aria-live polite.
Pri (QA): copy mismatch: modal title says "Export vectors" but button is "Download". pick one. test cases: keyboard path, NVDA/VoiceOver, Excel/Sheets parse, locale decimal separators.
Quinn (Support): include collapsed "Show example headers" in modal and a small privacy hint when source_text is checked. reduces tickets.
Lina (Design): proposed modal copy: title "Export vectors"; helper "Includes vector ids and scores. Toggle to include original source text (opt-in)."; checkbox "Include original source text (opt-in)"; primary "Download CSV"; example toggle collapsed by default.
Marcus (Product): add limit note: "Up to 10k vectors. Larger exports run in background; you'll get a link when ready."
Noor (Eng): backend note: for large exports we should offer background job with progress + cancel + job id. will emit a link on completion.
Ollie (A11y): background job completion must trigger an accessible notification (role=alert) with a clear link and description. job list should be keyboard navigable.
Pri (QA): QA action items: keyboard-only expand/collapse; modal focus trap; aria announcements for start/completion; CSV parse tests with decimal locales and Excel/LibreOffice; background job cancel flow.
i18n-bot: reminder: provide separate strings for numbers/limits (e.g., "%d vectors") and avoid concatenated copy.
Lina (Design): action items: Noor to spec export formats & estimates; Ollie to post a11y acceptance criteria; Pri to draft QA checklist; Quinn to write support blurb. I'll update Figma and push frames in ~2 hours. :rocket:
